study: Brooks platinum validation: rule selection and pools

paneStructure.note: reverse = every setup placement with flipped toggled

budget.rule: setup <= 2 optimized inputs and <= 25 iterations; pane 2, stops and switches pinned; each pane-4 exit <= 1 optimized input and <= 4 values; only one pane-4 group per version, so worst = setup x 4

drawConstraints.pane2NotInSetup: a pane-2 condition may not use a rule already placed in the family's pane 1
drawConstraints.intradayCapForAnyFamilies: at most 1 intraday-only member across panes 3+4, and at most 1 intraday-effective switch, for families tagged 'any'; no cap for intraday-only families
drawConstraints.switchKinds: at most one equity-profit and at most one equity-loss switch per family
drawConstraints.balance: least-used-first per pool with seeded random tie-breaks; the best of 200 seeded attempts by total count spread is kept

families.label: Bull/bear reversal bar at a new N-bar extreme
families.reason: Brooks's reversal bar that actually reverses something: a new low plus a strong close, not a shape anywhere.

families.label: Three-bar reversal
families.reason: Named Brooks setup (two-bar reversal around a small middle bar); no Davey analogue.

families.label: Failed reversal bar (trapped traders)
families.reason: Brooks's trap logic: a bear reversal bar that is immediately taken out traps the shorts.

families.label: Strong reversal bar ending a pullback
families.reason: With-trend pullback entry on a strong signal bar (high-1 proxy without the counter).

families.label: Exhaustion bar after a trend bar
families.reason: Shrinking body plus a rejection tail after a trend bar: Brooks's exhaustion read.

families.label: Two-bar reversal, entered beyond both bars
families.reason: Two-bar reversal with Brooks's entry beyond both bars (avoids the one-tick trap).

families.label: Outside bar closing beyond the prior bar
families.reason: Outside-bar breakout bar; the inside-bar variants are BAS-23 duplicates, the outside bar is not.

families.label: Doji after a large opposite trend bar
families.reason: Possible sell climax: a big bear trend bar met by a doji (Brooks's 'no follow-through').
families.note: Grid pulled below the 2.0-ATR default: at 2.0 x ATR the M1440 rate is ~1/160 per side. Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Micro measuring gap
families.reason: Brooks-specific strength sign: the bar after a trend bar does not overlap the bar before it.

families.label: First pullback after a spike (high 1)
families.reason: Named Brooks setup: the high 1 of a strong spike.
families.note: spikeBars 3 is the selective corner (~1/120 daily bars per side). Original grid restored 2026-11-05 by Brian: a low daily trade count (trials: spikeBars 2 = 3 median M1440 trades) is accepted to keep the 2-3 bar spike.

families.label: Limit buy below a spike bar
families.reason: Brooks's 'buy below the low of a bull spike bar' limit-order fade of the first dip.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Failed breakout of a micro channel
families.reason: Brooks: the first break of a micro channel usually fails and the channel resumes.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Pullback in a tight channel
families.reason: Buy the first meaningful dip of a tight channel (net progress, shallow pullbacks).

families.label: Largest trend bar of the run (faded)
families.reason: Brooks's 'biggest bull bar of the trend' exhaustion read; the setup is the fade, so it is placed flipped.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: End of a trend-bar run (faded)
families.reason: Fade the bar that ends a climactic run of trend bars; placed flipped (authored long = bull run ended).

families.label: Consecutive climaxes (faded)
families.reason: Brooks: two or three separated buy climaxes bring a two-legged correction; placed flipped.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Single climax bar (faded)
families.reason: A huge strong trend bar as a buy/sell climax; placed flipped. Grid sits below the 2-ATR default for daily counts.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Spike reversed by an opposite spike
families.reason: Spike-and-opposite-spike reversal; authored orientation kept as the setup (see judgement calls).

families.label: Failed breakout of the N-bar range
families.reason: Brooks's most-stated idea: most breakouts fail; take the reversal back inside.

families.label: Breakout pullback
families.reason: Three-stage breakout, pullback, resumption entry; not a Donchian breakout.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Breakout test of the swing level
families.reason: The pullback that tests a broken swing high and holds; ATR tolerance widened for daily bars.

families.label: Second failed breakout attempt
families.reason: Brooks's second-attempt principle applied to range breakouts.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Delayed first pullback after a breakout
families.reason: Brooks's leading strength sign: the first pullback comes only after several bars.

families.label: High 2 / low 2
families.reason: The core Brooks setup, on the settled leg counter.

families.label: Second signal (second entry)
families.reason: Brooks's second-entry principle as a generic trigger.

families.label: Failed high/low count reverses
families.reason: A failed high 2/3/4 hands control to the other side.

families.label: Three-push (wedge) reversal
families.reason: Brooks's wedge reversal on confirmed pivots.

families.label: Three-push breakout of the far side
families.reason: The wedge entry on the break of the opposite swing.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Three-push extreme retest faded
families.reason: Double-top/bottom test of a wedge extreme; kept for the bucket despite the count risk.
families.note: Row says keep swingStrength >= 2. Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Final-flag reversal
families.reason: Named Brooks setup: the last flag of a mature trend breaks the wrong way.

families.label: Twenty-gap-bar pullback to the EMA
families.reason: Brooks's '20 gap bar' first touch of the average; grid pulled down from 20 for daily counts.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Pullback to a sloping EMA
families.reason: Touch and close back above a steep EMA; not an MA cross or MA-side rule.

families.label: Moving-average gap-bar breakout
families.reason: Brooks's MA gap bar: the bar beyond the EMA, then a break of its far extreme.

families.label: Trend-line touch
families.reason: With-trend buy at the bull trend line drawn through confirmed swing lows.

families.label: Second trend-line test
families.reason: Second-entry principle applied to a line test.

families.label: Trend-line break
families.reason: First close through the opposite trend line; the first step of every Brooks reversal.

families.label: Major trend reversal
families.reason: The named Brooks MTR (line break, test of the extreme, reversal bar). Tick tolerance gridded wide.
families.note: tolTicks 5/45/85 spans intraday to daily scale; the walkforward picks per unit. Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Failed break of a micro trend line
families.reason: Brooks: micro trend line breaks usually fail and become with-trend entries.

families.label: Channel-line overshoot reversal
families.reason: Brooks's most-repeated channel trade: fade an overshoot of the channel line.

families.label: Failed channel breakout
families.reason: A close beyond a channel line that closes back inside runs to the opposite side.

families.label: Retest of the channel start
families.reason: Brooks: a channel is commonly retraced to its start, which then holds.

families.label: Fade the extreme of a trading range
families.reason: Buy low, sell high only inside a range; the range gate separates it from Davey's range-position rules.

families.label: Swing-point test that holds
families.reason: A test of the last swing low that does not trade through: Brooks's higher-low / double-bottom test.

families.label: Double-bottom bull flag / double-top bear flag
families.reason: Brooks's double-bottom pullback; the tick match gridded wide so daily pivots can qualify.
families.note: matchTicks 4/44/84 for the same scale reason as MajorTrendReversal.

families.label: Stop run reclaimed, re-entered on a stop
families.reason: Swing-low stop run that closes back above, entered above the reclaim bar.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

families.label: Failed countertrend scalp
families.reason: Three-bar trap: the countertrend signal triggers and immediately fails.

families.label: Fade at the measured-move target
families.reason: Measured-move targets as magnets; the setup is the fade at the target, so it is placed flipped.

families.label: Failed breakout of the prior session's extreme
families.reason: Brooks's failed breakout of yesterday's high/low early in the day.

families.label: Breakout of the session's first bar
families.reason: Brooks's first-bar breakout (second or third bar of the day through bar 1).

families.label: Opening trend bar reversed by bar 2
families.reason: Brooks's opening reversal: bar 2 reverses a strong first bar beyond its open.
families.note: Grid changed by the 2026-11-05 trial runs (SELECTION.md).

trend.note: always-in stand-in: 7 of the last 10 closes beyond the 20 EMA
tight channel: 2 ATR progress, pullbacks <= 1 ATR
last confirmed swing low above the one before
bull trend bars outnumber bear by >= 3 in 20
no two consecutive closes on the wrong side of the EMA in 10 bars
no close more than 1 ATR through the EMA in 20 bars
the with-trend line has not been closed through in 20 bars (flipped + negated)

reversal.note: Brooks's permission: the opposing trend line closed through in the last 20 bars
never fade a tight channel (flipped + negated)
not 20 straight closes on the other side of the EMA
the opposing trend's swings are shrinking
the move being reversed: 7 of 10 closes on the other side of the EMA

range.note: not in the middle third of the 20-bar range

signalBar.note: signal bar closes in the trade direction or beyond its midpoint
signal bar is a strong trend bar in the trade direction
signal bar range <= 1.5 x the 20-bar mean
no large tail against the trade unless the body is strong

stopPool.note: the Davey families' catastrophic stop, same value
daily-ok: on M1440 the ADR is the mean bar range; reach is maxScanBars + 1, so maxScanBars 499 fits Max Bars Back 500, which every family drawing this stop gets (Brian, 2026-11-05)
degenerates to one bar's range on M1440

exitPool.note: scalp to the signal bar's far extreme
exits on any return to the entry price: short trades
fires every bar on M1440 (bar close = session close), as in the Davey families

switchPool.note: cap 3 trades/session (book 3-5); inert on M1440 where a session is one bar
a one-bar loss stop on M1440
directional: blocks and flattens counter-MA trades
